title: Pipeline step 05: Visual Director
description: decks/<id>/pipeline/05-visual.yaml. Deck palette + one scene-only prompt per card. Style, safety and composition text are added by build_generation_prompt(), never written here.

new_characters.description: Keys that still need characters/{key}/character.yaml + an identity sheet before any card image

characters_in_scene.description: Library keys only (characters/{key}/). Max 4 (Nano Banana 2 limit).

image_prompt.description: Scene only: what is happening, who does what, the feeling

style_plate.description: Optional override of the plate mapping in style/style_config.yaml

continuity_ref.description: Earlier card_id (same place, new moment), e.g. 'story_1'

text_ref.description: The verses this scene shows (same as 02-structure / the 01 text map)

exclude.description: Visual things from the text map's not_in_text that the picture must leave out (e.g. 'the sun', 'animals'). Added to the prompt as exclusions

villain_posture.description: For villains: the sulky/comic posture used (no pointing, no snarling)
